hooks.command: CHANGED=$( { git diff --name-only HEAD; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } 2>/dev/null | sort -u); OUTSIDE=$(echo "$CHANGED" | grep -vE '^(docs/changes/|\.claude/|$)' | head -1); INSIDE=$(echo "$CHANGED" | grep '^docs/changes/' | head -1); if [ -n "$OUTSIDE" ] && [ -z "$INSIDE" ]; then echo '{"systemMessage": "⚠️ 缺少变更记录！检测到代码修改但 docs/changes/ 未更新，请按规则 6 创建变更记录。"}'; else echo '{}'; fi
